label: Love: thin q.20 willing-good love, hiddenness perfect love, love of a possessed good
resolution: LOVE_1 is the thin non-passional q.20 a.2 sense (ac87be3d-537d-440e-a38c-cb4839d5bedc): willing some good to the beloved suffices by the OPEN rule WillingGoodEntailsLove. The registered lovesAllExisting result (e3d5bece-f216-4877-9fca-8a1eb7d96bcd) proves LOVE_1 only. LOVE_2 is the hiddenness challenge's perfect love (4b2943ad-3bc5-5492-94bc-f21e9f1a12ab), which seeks personal relationship with capable creatures. LOVE_3 is love as an exercise of will affirming a possessed apprehended good (9f448669-6387-5244-a2ec-f9f90618c037). No argument passes between these senses. Transfer from LOVE_1 to LOVE_2 needs an explicit OPEN sense bridge, owned by #1735. LOVE_1 and LOVE_3 may coincide for God's love of His own good, but no such identification is asserted. Implication, independence and strength order between the senses are untested.
